{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Display the result
print('Mean flipper length by species:\n', mean_flipper_by_species)

# Find the species with the highest mean
species_with_highest_mean = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Output the species
species_with_highest_mean"}
